hebrewText: עֲזֻב֖וֹת עָרֵ֣י עֲרֹעֵ֑ר לַ/עֲדָרִ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ינָה וְ/רָבְצ֖וּ וְ/אֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד

tokens.bdb: to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.
tokens.kjv: commit self, fail, forsake, fortify, help, leave (destitute, off), refuse, [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
tokens.enLiteralWord: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.explanationEn: a city  in the widest sense

tokens.bdb: Aroer, the name of three places in or near Palestine
to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: to crouch (on all four legs folded, like a recumbent animal); be implication, to recline, repose, brood, lurk, imbed
tokens.kjv: crouch (down), fall down, make a fold, lay, (cause to, make to) lie (down), make to rest, sit.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to crouch (on all four legs folded
tokens.enLiteralWord: to crouch (on all four legs folded
tokens.explanation: to crouch (on all four legs folded
tokens.explanationEn: to crouch (on all four legs folded

tokens.bdb: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.enLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanation: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanationEn: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle

tokens.bdb: to shudder with terror; hence, to fear; also to hasten (with anxiety)
tokens.kjv: be (make) afraid, be careful, discomfit, fray (away), quake, tremble.
